channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: ‘Daily Show’-Inspired Guerrilla Press Podcast Aims To Engage Chicago’s Young Progressives
item.description: Nick Hausman and EJ Cameron launched Guerrilla Press last month with a weekly live podcast at The Annoyance Theatre.

item.title: Chicago Traffic Deaths Reach A 9-Year Low, But Funding Cuts Could Threaten Progress
item.description: The city recorded 100 traffic deaths last year, the lowest since 2016. But some advocates say city bond funding for the Complete Streets and Vision Zero programs are set to decrease 85 percent by 2029 — while the city contends its investment in transit is at an "all-time high."

item.title: 2 Lots On Bucktown Block Could Become 60 Apartments If Separate Developments Are Approved
item.description: The vacant lots near the Western Blue Line stop would be home to new four-story and five-story apartment buildings.

item.title: How Creamy Garlic Dressing Went From ’70s Food Star To Chicago’s Best-Kept Secret
item.description: This aromatic accompaniment to wedge salads, pizza and wings had its heyday in the ‘70s, but fans and recipe hounds still clamor for a taste.

item.title: Chicago Just Named A Snowplow ‘Abolish ICE’— Here Are The Other Winners
item.description: The city received a record number of entries and votes for its annual snowplow-naming contest. The Department of Streets and Sanitation announced the six winners Monday.

item.title: ‘My Best Friend Is Black’ Comedy Troupe Set To Shake Up City Winery
item.description: Known for their quirky, variety-style show at Lincoln Lodge, the group’s core members will perform Tuesday for their biggest crowd yet, said member Marcus Banks.

item.title: Former Bacci Pizzeria Building In Ukrainian Village To Be Torn Down For Condos
item.description: A zoning change to construct a five-story, six-unit condo building was approved by the City Council last week to replace the closed pizza shop on Chicago Avenue.

item.title: Broadview Protesters Lean On New Body-Camera Footage To Refute Prosecutors’ Conspiracy Claims
item.description: In one image, Kat Abughazaleh is seen holding a microphone. Defense attorneys said she urged protesters to step away from private property.

item.title: ‘Survivor’ Fans Pack Brown Line Train For 50th Season Idol Scavenger Hunt
item.description: CTA brown line cars served as a temporary Survivor set as fans swarmed the Kimball station on Saturday for a chance to find one of the show's hidden immunity idols.

item.title: Soldier Field After The Bears? Park District Pitches Plan For Year-Round Concert, Events Venue
item.description: The city is lobbying for massive infrastructure upgrades to Soldier Field for concerts and special events — even if the Bears break their lease for the suburbs or Indiana.
